module: Fallback data stream for the rally stage UI apps when no rally loop feeds them (stage launched on its own, "standalone"). It keeps the latest data received from a countdown node (active state, countdown, vehicle proximity, clock) and completes it with the stage data from the rally manager (gameplay_rally.getRallyManager():getActiveStageData()), the environment clock, the theme colors and the rallyShowStageApps setting. getStreamData returns the table to send to the UI.
notes: A received stream stays "fresh" for 0.75 s (fallbackFreshTime); beyond that it is only used if the stage is present or active.
The countdown is protected for 0.75 s after each update (0.1 s for the GO display, countdown == 0): an incoming non-countdown state is ignored during that delay.
data.resetFallbackStreamData = true clears the state then creates a reset stream with fallbackStageResetActive.
NGRC mode is inferred from gameplay_rally.getRecoveryRepairVehicle() (NGRC = no vehicle repair).
The theme is colored with uiColors.updateForStage.

clear.desc: Clears the whole fallback stream state (data, delays, clock, reset flag).

isActive.desc: Indicates whether the stream should be used: fallback data exists or a stage is active on the rally manager side.

updateClock.desc: Advances the local wall clock (fallbackClockSecs) by dtSim seconds, modulo 86400, if it was initialized by a node.

getStreamData.desc: Builds the stream table for the UI: activeState, rallyClock, stageData, scheduleData, vehicleProximity, countdownData, showStageApps, uiColors. Chooses between the updated fallback stream, the stand-alone stage data (stageActive state) or an inactive state with reset data.

now.desc: Current time (RallyUtil.getTime() or os.clockhp() by default).

updateStreamData.desc: Records a data packet coming from a node (activeState, vehicleProximity, countdownData, rallyClock, resetFallbackStreamData) and manages the countdown protection delays and the GO display delay.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when settings change: rereads rallyShowStageApps (true by default).
